module_summary: Mostly headers for the C++ menu ELF: RAII helpers (UniqueFd, UniquePtr/makeUnique in malloc memory, ScopeExit, SemaLock), class declarations for the GS renderer, sound effects, the Settings shell, the source registry, the theme catalog and internal constants shared by texcache/themes, the Hoehrmann UTF-8 DFA decoder, util.h prototypes and opl.h (the global settings variables and IO request ids). host.h/host.cpp define the four service interfaces (UI, app, library, launch) the support backends call instead of opl.cpp/gui.cpp, with OplLaunch filling the feature-derived ee_core config (cheats, PS2RD image, GSM, IGR menu, RetroAchievements work area). autolaunch.cpp handles argv-driven HDL and BDM autolaunch before the menu exists, and lwnbdctl.cpp tears the menu down to run the lwNBD server and restores it afterwards.

findings.title: lwnbdctl.cpp: NBD start/stop 'bounded' waits treat delay() ticks as milliseconds (IO drain ~4 min, pad retries up to ~20 min)
findings.problem: delay() spins 0x01000000 x 4 nops per tick, ~0.25 s (util.cpp:941-950; the repo records this at opl.cpp:1269-1277). ioBlockOpsTimed spends one delay(1) per tick (ioman.cpp:380-386), so LWNBD_IO_DRAIN_TICKS = 1000, meant to fail a stuck request quickly, spins the GUI thread for ~250 s behind the frozen 'Starting NBD' screen. Both pad-restart loops wait delay(50) (~12.5 s) per failed startPads(), up to 100 times (~20 min), where the comment at 228-231 promises ~5 s. LWNBD_ART_DRAIN_TICKS = 500 next to it is milliseconds (artload.cpp:426-449), so the two *_TICKS constants differ in unit by ~250x.
findings.fix: Set LWNBD_IO_DRAIN_TICKS to about 4 (~1 s, the same value opl.cpp:1276 already uses for EXIT_IO_DRAIN_TICKS) and note the unit. In both pad loops replace delay(50) with DelayThread(50000) so 100 tries are the documented ~5 s (move the delaythread.h include out of the __OPLDIAG block), or keep delay() and use delay(1) with 20 tries.
findings.benefit: On NBD start/stop failure paths the screen freezes ~1 s / ~5 s as documented instead of ~250 s / up to ~20 min. Timing INFERRED: 16.8M loop iterations per tick at 294.9 MHz is ~0.25 s, the figure opl.cpp:1269-1272 and artload.cpp:426-427 state.
findings.evidence: Read lwnbdctl.cpp:77-78,141-154,192-203,228-239; ioman.cpp:360-398 (blockOps: while hasPending, delay(1), timeoutTicks--) and 467-476; util.cpp:941-950; opl.cpp:1269-1277 (same units trap already fixed there: EXIT 4, LAUNCH 40 ticks); artload.cpp:426-454 and hddsupport.cpp:308-312 (art waits are DelayThread(1000) per tick = ms); pad.cpp:1155-1200 (startPads returns 0 when no port opens, e.g. after a half-done IOP reset as the 228-231 comment anticipates). Caller: menusys.cpp:2380-2382 MENU_NBD on the GUI thread. The tick duration is computed, not measured on hardware.

findings.title: settingshell.h: mmceDialog_ reserves 256 UIItems (10 KB .bss) for a page of at most ~45 rows
findings.problem: SettingsShell holds two UIItem[SETTINGS_DIALOG_CAPACITY=256] arrays. mmceDialog_ is used only by guiShowMmceConfig (guisettings.cpp:377), which composes diaMmceConfig + diaMmceCommConfig + diaMmcePathConfig (dialogs.cpp:816-942, 43 source rows before skips). sizeof(struct UIItem) is 40 bytes (dia.h:72-121), so mmceDialog_ is 10,240 bytes of .bss of which ~8 KB is never used.
findings.fix: Size mmceDialog_ to 64 entries and let composeInto bound by the destination size (pass the capacity instead of using SETTINGS_DIALOG_CAPACITY at guisettings.cpp:2117 and 2125).
findings.justification: The capacity parameter is the only addition: without it composeInto would check a 64-entry buffer against 256 and could overflow. It costs one argument and saves ~7.7 KB of EE .bss.
findings.benefit: ~7.7 KB .bss: (256 - 64) x 40 B = 7,680 B. MEASURED total: gSettingsShell is 0x50bc = 20,668 B in evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-nm-size-sorted.full.txt:45; the 40 B UIItem size is INFERRED from dia.h.
findings.evidence: grep mmceDialog over src: settingshell.h:49,73 and guisettings.cpp:377 only. Counted rows in dialogs.cpp:816-850 (23), 854-875 (11), 926-942 (9). Layout of struct UIItem from dia.h:72-121: 16 B header + 20 B union (intvalue: 4 ints + pointer) + 1 B flag, padded to 40. nm: gSettingsShell B 0x50bc.

findings.title: utf8.h: the 400-byte static utf8d table is linked twice (fntsys.cpp and textshape.cpp)
findings.problem: utf8.h defines utf8d as a static const array and utf8Decode as a static function, so each including translation unit gets its own copy. The shipped ELF holds two 400-byte _ZL5utf8d objects.
findings.fix: Define the table and utf8Decode once (for example in fntsys.cpp) and leave only a prototype in utf8.h, or make both inline (inline constexpr table) so the linker keeps one copy.
findings.benefit: 400 B .rodata. MEASURED: two _ZL5utf8d entries of size 0x190 in evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-nm-size-sorted.full.txt:1757-1758.
findings.evidence: grep 'include.*utf8.h|utf8Decode' over src/RiptOPL (c,cpp,h,py): included only by src/gfx/fntsys.cpp:12 and src/gfx/textshape.cpp:12, both compiled into the main ELF (ps2.yaml src/gfx glob per brief). nm shows 005dc7d0 and 005dceb8, each 00000190 r _ZL5utf8d.

findings.title: autolaunch.cpp: mass0 retry waits delay(6) twice per attempt, so the documented ~12 s bound is ~24 s
findings.problem: When mass0: does not open, the retry branch runs delay(6) and i--, and then the loop tail runs delay(6) again, so each of the AUTOLAUNCH_MASS0_RETRIES = 8 attempts (oplint.h:10) costs 12 ticks. The comment at 203-205 sizes the bound as 8 x 6 ticks of ~0.25 s = ~12 s; the real black-screen wait before falling back to the menu is ~24 s plus the initial delay(8).
findings.fix: Delete the delay(6) inside the retry branch (line 243); the loop-tail delay(6) already spaces the attempts.
findings.benefit: No-device BDM autolaunch falls back to the menu after ~12 s instead of ~26 s (INFERRED: 8 x 12 + 8 = 104 ticks vs 8 x 6 + 8 = 56 ticks at ~0.25 s per tick). 1 line removed.
findings.evidence: Read autolaunch.cpp:203-250 (control flow: else-branch delay(6); i--; then unconditional delay(6) at 249; break skips it). oplint.h:10 AUTOLAUNCH_MASS0_RETRIES = 8. Tick length from util.cpp:941-950 and the repo note at opl.cpp:1269-1272. Called from opl.cpp:2103-2106 when argv[4] is bdm or ata.
